podcast.body: This song was released in early 2022 by NHC, Taylor Hawkins' most recent side project before his death. The band's sound was described by Taylor as falling "somewhere between Rush and the Faces," showcasing a unique blend of influences. "Released in early 2022, that's Taylor Hawkins and NHC, his Fouce Fighter side project, with Feed the Cruel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
